name: Select
tooltip:
Selection is always active and the active selection mode displays here.

Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Change the active selection mode by selecting the mode you want to work with from the menu. Use the selection mode and selection filters to fine tune selection.

name: Selection Filters
tooltip:
Specifies which object types can be selected.

Use Select All to include or exclude all object types. Check only specific types to limit selection to those types. Check Select Through to enable selection of hidden objects during Window or Freeform selection.

name: Select Face Priority
tooltip:
Sets the selection filter to Body Faces, and prevents selection of other object types.

Click a face to select it. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Click Select Face Priority again to restore selection of any object type.

name: Select Body Priority
tooltip:
Sets the selection filter to Bodies, and prevents selection of other object types.

Click a body to select it. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Click Select Body Priority again to restore selection of any object type.

name: Select Edge Priority
tooltip:
Sets the selection filter to Body Edges, and prevents selection of other object types.

Click an edge on a body to select it. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Click Select Edge Priority again to restore selection of any object type.

name: Select Component Priority
tooltip:
Sets the selection filter to Components, and prevents selection of other object types.

Click a component to select it. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (MacOS) to add objects to or remove objects from the selection. Click Select Component Priority again to restore selection of any object type.

name: Capture Image...
tooltip:
Captures the current canvas as an image.

Set the image size and resolution then set the file type (*.png, *.jpg, *.tiff) and file name.

name: New...
tooltip: Create a new Part, Assembly, Hybrid, or Electronics Design, a Drawing for the active design, or an Electronics Library.

name: Visualize tab for a document asset
Save
tooltip:
Saves a design to a selected location within a project.

Save your design frequently to prevent loss of work in the event of a power failure or unexpected crash.

name: Create Version
tooltip:
Marks the current state of the design as a significant iteration.

By default, the latest version of your design is the one referenced by other designs. Changes don't appear in external references until you create a new version of your design.

name: Test Toolkit
tooltip:
INTERNAL USE ONLY

Used to develop advanced toolbar handling. Don't do this at home kids!

name: Layout Option
tooltip:
INTERNAL USE ONLY

Used to test option group!

name: Scripts and Add-Ins...
tooltip:
Manage Scripts and Add-Ins

Displays the Scripts and Add-Ins dialog box. Create, edit, run, stop, debug and manage Scripts and Add-Ins.

name: Open Recovered Documents (0)
tooltip:
Opens the Document Recovery dialog and displays a list of recovery documents.

Recovery documents are cached locally. Use them to recover design data if Fusion closes unexpectedly.

In Preferences, set the Automatic Backup Interval to control how frequently data is backed up.

name: Old User To Team From Invite
Share File Link
tooltip:
Creates a shareable link so that viewers can download the design, view it online, or share it with others.

You can protect the link with a password; the design can be viewed in the cloud even without Fusion installed.

name: Render
tooltip:
Creates a high-quality rendered image of your scene using cloud or local background rendering technology.

Choose the desired image size, settings, cloud or local render, and click Render to start the rendering process. Finished renderings will appear in your Rendering Gallery.

name: Transfer files from personal to team hub
Execute a command on New Data Panel component
Execute a command on HomeTab component
Preview Image
tooltip: Preview image in a dialog window.

name: Paste
tooltip: Paste Command

name: Manage Materials
tooltip:
Opens the Material Browser, where you can manage physical materials and appearances in user-defined material libraries.

Navigate between libraries, create new libraries, and add physical materials or appearances to your Favorites. In custom libraries, edit the properties of physical materials and appearances, or create new ones.

name: Show All Components
tooltip: Turns on the visibility of selected components, including child components.

name: Interactive command to run Python Script...
Sequential command to run Python Script...
Measure
tooltip:
Measures the distance, angle, area, or position of selected objects.

Select an object to measure it, and optionally select a second object to measure it and the distance between them.

name: Extrude
tooltip:
Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or faces.

Select an extrusion type, select sketch profiles or faces to extrude, then specify the distance and taper angle. For the Thin Extrude type, specify the wall thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or faces.

Select an extrusion type, select sketch profiles or faces to extrude, then specify the distance and taper angle. For the Thin Extrude type, specify the wall thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or planar faces.

Select the profile or planar face then specify the distance to extrude.

name: Compute All
tooltip:
Computes all of the parameters, features, and assembly relationships in a design.

Use at major milestones in the design process and after making significant changes to features in the Timeline, to ensure all assembly relationships are calculated properly.

name: Change to Parametric Modeling
tooltip:
Change to Parametric Modeling Mode

Changes the modeling mode for the design:
  • Parametric: Captures parameters and features in the timeline as you create your design.
  • Direct: Deletes all parameters and features in the timeline and lets you edit the design more quickly.
Current mode: Direct

name: Offset Face
tooltip:
Shifts the selected face or faces in a positive or negative direction.

Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Shifts the selected face or faces in a positive or negative direction.

Select a single face or multiple faces and specify the Offset distance.

name: Extrude
tooltip:
Adds depth to open or closed sketch profiles or planar faces.

Select the profile or planar face then specify the distance to extrude.

name: Insert Component
tooltip:
Inserts the selected component into the current design.

Select the component to insert then use the manipulator to adjust the position.

name: Insert Component
tooltip:
Inserts the selected component into the current design.

Select the component to insert then use the manipulator to adjust the position.

name: Insert Component from a local File
Assign Item Number
tooltip:
Assign unique item numbers to selected components for tracking throughout their life cycles.

Items are set to “unreleased” and are accessible in Fusion Manage.

name: Quick Release
tooltip:
Transitions the component to the next life cycle state or revision without a change order.

The final release still requires a change order. This only works on the top level component or external references - not internal components.

name: Release with Change Order
tooltip:
Releases the selected components with a change order.

Includes full audit trail and approval workflow. Internal components and external references are supported.

name: Dashboard
tooltip:
Opens the Fusion Manage Dashboard in your default browser.

The Dashboard is a central place where you can access your Fusion Manage information, such as charts and outstanding work.

name: Details
tooltip:
Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows the Details page for the currently selected item.

If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of items and BOMs is shown.

name: Change Orders
tooltip:
Opens Fusion Manage in your default browser and shows change order information for the currently selected item.

If the current selection is not assigned as an item in Fusion Manage, the list of change orders is shown.

name: Bill of Materials
tooltip:
Opens the bill of materials for this design.

(May not be available in some situations, such as when viewing a configured design, or when Fusion is offline.)

name: Shared Part Number
tooltip:
Opens the list of members in Part Number Group .

(May not be available in offline.)

name: Delete
tooltip:
Permanently deletes selected objects, and everything related to them, from the design. Does not create a feature in the timeline. Deleted objects cannot be restored parametrically.

Select components, bodies, sketches, and construction objects to delete. Use the Remove command to preserve parametric history.

name: Resolve Component
tooltip:
Resolve selected missing xRef objects.

Select missing xRefs from browser tree or from timeline to resolve.

name: Scene Settings
tooltip: Set the environment and lighting for the scene. This setting only affects the Rendering workspace.

name: Appearance
tooltip:
Assigns appearances to components, bodies, or faces in a design to override the color and texture of their physical materials, without affecting physical engineering properties.

Choose whether to apply appearances to components and bodies or specific faces, then drag appearances onto components, bodies, or faces in the canvas or the Browser. In the In This Design section, right-click appearances to edit, duplicate, delete, or add them as favorites.

name: Physical Material
tooltip:
Assigns physical materials to components and bodies in a design to control their thermal, mechanical, strength, and advanced engineering properties, as well as their appearance.

Drag physical materials onto components or bodies in the canvas or the Browser. In the In This Design section, right-click physical materials to edit, duplicate, delete, or add them as favorites.

name: Fillet
tooltip:
Rounds the edges of a solid body by adding material to interior edges and removing material from exterior edges.

Select edges, faces, or features, then specify a radius. Use the Rule Fillet type to add fillets based on specified rules. Use the Full Round Fillet type to round the edges over three adjacent faces.

name: Gap Fill
tooltip:
Fills gaps in surfaces and shells.

Improves geometry by filling gaps between selected object edges. Choose the Extend or Patch options appropriate for the gap.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Fills gaps in surfaces and shells.

Improves geometry by filling gaps between selected object edges. Choose the Extend or Patch options appropriate for the gap.

name: Hole
tooltip:
Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections.

Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.

name: Edit Hole
tooltip:
Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections.

Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a hole based on user-specified values and selections.

Select a face to place the hole then select edges to position the hole on the face, or select sketch points to place multiple holes. Specify the hole type, tap type and size values.

name: Thread
tooltip:
Add internal or external threads to cylindrical geometry. Threads can be cosmetic or modeled on the geometry.

Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.

name: Edit Thread
tooltip:
Add internal or external threads to cylindrical geometry. Threads can be cosmetic or modeled on the geometry.

Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Add internal or external threads to cylindrical geometry. Threads can be cosmetic or modeled on the geometry.

Select a cylindrical face then set the thread specifications.

name: Chamfer
tooltip:
Bevels the edges of a solid or surface body by removing material from exterior edges or adding material to interior edges.

Select edges, faces, or features, then specify one distance, two distances, or a distance and an angle.

name: Replace Face
tooltip:
Replaces one or more part faces with different face. The new face must completely intersect the part.

Select the face to remove then select the new face.

name: Emboss
tooltip:
Raises or recesses a sketch profile relative to faces on a solid body by a specified depth and direction.

Select sketch profiles, select faces on a solid body to emboss, then adjust depth, effect, and alignment.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Raises or recesses a sketch profile relative to faces on a solid body by a specified depth and direction.

Select sketch profiles, select faces on a solid body to emboss, then adjust depth, effect, and alignment.

name: Edit Features
tooltip:
Replaces one or more part faces with different face. The new face must completely intersect the part.

Select the face to remove then select the new face.

name: Shell
tooltip:
Offsets the walls of a solid body to create a hollow cavity with walls of a specified thickness.

Select a body to shell or faces to remove to create an opening, then specify a type, direction, and wall thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Offsets the walls of a solid body to create a hollow cavity with walls of a specified thickness.

Select a body to shell or faces to remove to create an opening, then specify a type, direction, and wall thickness.

name: Move/Copy
tooltip:
Moves the selected face, body, sketch, or construction geometry a specified distance or angle.

Select the objects to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.

name: Duplicate With Joints
tooltip:
Duplicates components in an assembly and the joints attached to them.

Select components to duplicate, select a Joint Origin Mode, then select a Snap point to place each instance. If a component has multiple joints, select the next row in the selection box, then select a Snap point to place each instance.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Moves the selected face, body, sketch, or construction geometry a specified distance or angle.

Select the objects to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Moves the selected face, body, sketch, or construction geometry a specified distance or angle.

Select the objects to modify then specify the distance or angle. Use Set Pivot to reposition the manipulator.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Moves an object (component, body, sketch, work geometry) by aligning geometry selected from the object with geometry selected elsewhere. Geometry can be a point, line, plane, circle, or coordinate system. Snaps are treated as full coordinate systems for full position and orientation alignment.

Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.

name: Drive Joints
tooltip: Specify the rotation angle or distance value for joint degrees of freedom.

name: Align
tooltip:
Moves an object (component, body, sketch, work geometry) by aligning geometry selected from the object with geometry selected elsewhere. Geometry can be a point, line, plane, circle, or coordinate system. Snaps are treated as full coordinate systems for full position and orientation alignment.

Select the point on the object to move then select the point on the face to align to. Click Flip and Angle to rotate the object.

name: New Contact Set
tooltip:
Creates a contact set between selected components.

Select the bodies or components to participate in the contact analysis.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Creates a contact set between selected components.

Select the bodies or components to participate in the contact analysis.

name: Enable Contact Sets
tooltip: Activates contact analysis between components in contact sets. Contact sets are managed in the browser.

name: Enable All Contact
tooltip: Activates contact analysis for all components.

name: Disable Contact
tooltip: Turns off contact analysis for all component.

name: Lock Motion
tooltip: Locks the joint in place and prevents it from moving until you unlock it.

name: Unlock Motion
tooltip: Unlocks joint motion.

name: Motion Study
tooltip:
Performs kinematic motion analysis based on joints.

Select the joints to participate then specify points and values for the motion.

name: Component Drag
tooltip:
Enables or disables the movement of components by dragging in the canvas.

Hold Alt to drag components when Component Drag is disabled.

name: Joint Inconsistency Resolver
tooltip: FusionJointInconsistencyResolverCommand

name: Scale
tooltip:
Scales sketch objects, bodies, or components.

Select the objects to scale then specify the scale factor.

name: Interference
tooltip:
Reports the interference between selected solid bodies or components.

Select the components then click compute. Choose to create components from the interferences.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Scales sketch objects, bodies, or components.

Select the objects to scale then specify the scale factor.

name: Create Sketch
tooltip:
Enters Sketch mode, where you create geometric profiles that define the foundation of a design. Then use commands like Extrude, Revolve, and Loft to create 3D bodies from sketches.

Select a construction plane, then create lines, arcs, or points to create sketch and construction geometry. Constrain sketches with dimensions and constraints. Select Finish Sketch to exit Sketch mode.

name: Finish Sketch
tooltip: Exits the edit sketch state.

name: Finish with AutoConstrain
tooltip:
No sketches to constrain.

Add a sketch and then run this tool to automatically generate options to dimension and constrain your sketch.

name: Line
tooltip:
Creates lines and arcs.

Select a start and endpoint to define a line segment. Click and drag the endpoint of a segment to define an arc.

name: Thicken
tooltip:
Adds thickness to surface faces to create a solid body.

Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.

name: Draft
tooltip:
Applies a fixed or parting line draft angle to planar faces.

Select a pull direction, parting tool, and faces to draft, then specify the draft angle.

name: Combine
tooltip:
Joins, cuts, or intersects two or more solid bodies to create a single solid body.

Select the target body, select one or more tool bodies to combine with the target body, then select the operation to use to combine the bodies together.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Joins, cuts, or intersects two or more solid bodies to create a single solid body.

Select the target body, select one or more tool bodies to combine with the target body, then select the operation to use to combine the bodies together.

name: Split Body
tooltip:
Creates new bodies by dividing selected bodies using a profile, face, or plane.

Select the bodies to modify then select the profile, face, or plane that divides the bodies.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates new bodies by dividing selected bodies using a profile, face, or plane.

Select the bodies to modify then select the profile, face, or plane that divides the bodies.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Splits a body using surfaces generated from its silhouette curves.

Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Divides faces using a selected profile, face, or plane as the cutting tool.

Select the faces to modify then select the profile, face, or plane that divides the source face.

name: Split Face
tooltip:
Divides faces using a selected profile, face, or plane as the cutting tool.

Select the faces to modify then select the profile, face, or plane that divides the source face.

name: Silhouette Split
tooltip:
Splits a body using surfaces generated from its silhouette curves.

Set the view direction by selecting a plane or axis then select the body and choose a split operation.

name: Revolve
tooltip:
Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

name: Texture Map Controls
tooltip:
Sets the orientation of the texture applied to the body or component.

Select the object to modify then the Projection Type and the Axis. Modify the Mapping Transform using the manipulator or fields in the dialog.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

name: Sweep
tooltip:
Sweeps a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body along a selected path.

Select a sweep type, an object and a path to sweep along, then specify the operation. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the sweep.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Sweeps a sketch profile, planar face, or a solid body along a selected path.

Select a sweep type, an object and a path to sweep along, then specify the operation. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the sweep.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Sweeps a sketch profile or planar face along a selected path.

Select the profile then select the sweep path. The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the selected path.

name: Loft
tooltip:
Creates a transitional shape between two or more sketch profiles or planar faces.

Select a series of profiles or planar faces to define a shape. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the shape.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a transitional shape between two or more sketch profiles or planar faces.

Select a series of profiles or planar faces to define a shape. Optionally select rails or a centerline to guide the shape.

name: Loft
tooltip:
Creates a transitional shape between two or more sketch profiles or planar faces.

Select at least two profiles to define the loft. Refine the shape by using rail or centerline guides or point mapping.

name: Rib
tooltip:
Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The rib feature is extruded in a direction parallel to the sketch plane.

Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The rib feature is extruded in a direction parallel to the sketch plane.

Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

name: Web
tooltip:
Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The web feature is extruded in a direction perpendicular to the sketch plane.

Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a thin feature from an open sketch profile, extruded to the nearest faces on a solid body. The web feature is extruded in a direction perpendicular to the sketch plane.

Select an open sketch profile, then specify the thickness.

name: Boundary Fill
tooltip:
Creates, joins or removes volumes using bounding volumes formed by tool selections.

Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates, joins or removes volumes using bounding volumes formed by tool selections.

Select solids, surfaces or workplanes as tools to form volumes (or cells). These cells can be used to cut existing solids or to join to existing solids or to create a new solid.

name: Loft
tooltip:
Creates a smooth shape that transitions between two or more sketch profiles or faces.

Select a series of profiles, planar faces, or non-planar faces to define the shape. Optionally, select rails or centerlines to guide the shape.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a smooth shape that transitions between two or more sketch profiles or faces.

Select a series of profiles, planar faces, or non-planar faces to define the shape. Optionally, select rails or centerlines to guide the shape.

name: Box
tooltip:
Creates a solid box.

Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box.

name: Box
tooltip:
Creates a surface body box.

Select a plane, draw a rectangle then specify the height of the box.

name: Cylinder
tooltip:
Creates a solid cylinder.

Select a plane, draw a circle then specify the height of the cylinder.

name: Cylinder
tooltip:
Creates a surface body cylinder.

Select a plane, draw a circle then specify the height of the cylinder.

name: Sphere
tooltip:
Creates a solid body sphere.

Select a plane then specify the center point of the sphere and the diameter.

name: Sphere
tooltip:
Creates a surface sphere.

Select a plane then specify the center point of the sphere and the diameter.

name: Torus
tooltip:
Creates a solid torus.

Specify the center point and diameter of the axis of revolution of the torus.

name: Torus
tooltip:
Creates a surface torus.

Specify the center point and diameter of the axis of revolution of the torus.

name: Coil
tooltip:
Creates a solid coil.

Select a plane then draw a circle to specify the major diameter of the coil. Finish defining the coil using the manipulators or dialog box.

name: Coil
tooltip:
Creates a surface coil.

Select a plane then draw a circle to specify the major diameter of the coil. Finish defining the coil using the manipulators or dialog box.

name: Connector Obstacle
tooltip:
Creates obstacle geometry bodies in locations of bolts or pins in an assembly.

Customize the size and shape of connector obstacles by adjusting the shaft length and diameter, and clearance for bolt heads, nuts, and tooling.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates obstacle geometry bodies in locations of bolts or pins in an assembly.

Customize the size and shape of connector obstacles by adjusting the shaft length and diameter, and clearance for bolt heads, nuts, and tooling.

name: Pipe
tooltip:
Creates a solid pipe that follows a selected path.

Select the path then specify the section and size.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a solid pipe that follows a selected path.

Select the path then specify the section and size.

name: Pipe
tooltip:
Creates a surface pipe that follows a selected path.

Select the path then specify the section and size.

name: 3D Print
tooltip:
Prepares solid or mesh bodies to be 3D printed directly from Fusion's Manufacture workspace or from an external application.

Select solid or mesh bodies to prepare, then select a Preparation Type to switch to the Manufacture workspace, export and send to an installed 3D printing application, or export a 3MF, STL, or OBJ file. For exports, adjust the output and refinement settings to control the resolution of the mesh.

name: Automated Modeling
tooltip:
Generates design alternatives between geometries in space that you want to connect.

Select at least two faces to connect. Optionally, you can select areas where you don't want to create new geometry. The alternatives are generated automatically. Explore them and select the alternative that best suits your needs.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Generates design alternatives between geometries in space that you want to connect.

Select at least two faces to connect. Optionally, you can select areas where you don't want to create new geometry. The alternatives are generated automatically. Explore them and select the alternative that best suits your needs.

name: Extend
tooltip:
Enlarges a surface by extending its edges a specified distance.

Select the edges of a surface, select an extension type, then specify the distance to extend. Select an edge alignment option to control the curvature continuity between faces.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Enlarges a surface by extending its edges a specified distance.

Select the edges of a surface, select an extension type, then specify the distance to extend. Select an edge alignment option to control the curvature continuity between faces.

name: Edit Face
tooltip:
Converts the selected face to T-Spline faces, edges, and vertices for modification.

Select the face to modify. Increase the length and width factors to add faces to give more control.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Rounds the edges of a solid body by adding material to interior edges and removing material from exterior edges.

Select edges, faces, or features, then specify a radius. Use the Rule Fillet type to add fillets based on specified rules. Use the Full Round Fillet type to round the edges over three adjacent faces.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Adds thickness to surface faces to create a solid body.

Select the faces to thicken, then specify a thickness value.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Bevels the edges of a solid or surface body by removing material from exterior edges or adding material to interior edges.

Select edges, faces, or features, then specify one distance, two distances, or a distance and an angle.

name: Display Configuration Table
tooltip: Shows or hides the Configure dialog without entering Configuration Mode.

name: Configure
tooltip:
Opens the Configuration Table, enters Configuration Mode, and highlights configurable features and objects in the Timeline and Browser.

Add Configurations as rows in the table to create different variants of a design. Click highlighted features and objects to add their configurable aspects as columns in the table.

name: Create Configuration Rules
tooltip:
Creates logical Configuration Rules that drive or limit configured aspect values in a Configured Design, to ensure only valid configurations can be created.

Drag and drop blocks into the Configuration Rules canvas to create logical rules, then apply them to the set of configurations.

name: Refresh row name in nested configuration
Compute Unresolved
tooltip:
Computes only the features related to unresolved external components in the assembly.

Only available when you open a design that contains unresolved external components. You must compute the features related to the unresolved components before you can edit or save the design.

name: Change Parameters
tooltip:
Displays the Parameters dialog, where you can create and manage equations and relationships to control the size of objects.

Edit the name, expression, and comments for parameters. Create User Parameters to use in other expressions.

name: Open Parameters Dialog in Configuration Mode
Change to Direct Modeling
tooltip:
Change to Direct Modeling Mode

Changes the modeling mode for the design:
  • Parametric: Captures parameters and features in the timeline as you create your design.
  • Direct: Deletes all parameters and features in the timeline and lets you edit the design more quickly.
Current mode: Parametric

name: Remove
tooltip:
Deletes selected components or bodies from the design and preserves the operation as a feature in the timeline. Removed objects can be restored parametrically.

Select components or bodies to remove. To permanently delete parametric history associated with an object, use the Delete command instead.

name: Finish Base Feature
tooltip: Return to the Design workspace.

name: Create Base Feature
tooltip:
Enters direct editing mode and inserts a history-free feature in the timeline. Actions performed while in the Base Feature are not recorded in the timeline.

Select Finish Base Feature to exit out of the mode.

name: Finish Form
tooltip: Return to the Design workspace.

name: Create Form
tooltip:
Enters Form mode and inserts a form feature into the timeline. Use form tools to create and edit history-free bodies by pushing and pulling on vertices, edges, and faces. This is commonly referred to as T-Spline modeling.

Select Finish Form to exit out of the mode.

name: Roll Timeline Marker Here
tooltip: Move the marker to this feature and shows the design at this point in the timeline.

name: Delete all features after History Marker
Capture Position
tooltip:
Captures the positions of recently moved/rotated components as an event in your timeline. This information is used by geometry and assemble commands.

Use this if you intend to continue modeling/assembling while keeping components at their current positions.

name: Revert Position
tooltip: Returns the components to the previous position and rotation.

name: Joint Origin
tooltip:
Positions a joint origin on a component. Joint origins define the geometry used to relate a joint's components.

Select geometry to define the joint origin.

name: Joint
tooltip:
Position components relative to each other in an assembly, then defines the relative motion between them.

On the Position tab, place a joint origin snap point on each component to position them. On the Motion tab, select the motion Type, then adjust associated settings, add joint limits, and preview joint motion.

name: Rigid Group
tooltip:
Locks the relative position of the selected components. The components are treated as a single object when moved or when joints are applied.

Select the components to group together.

name: Edit Rigid Group
tooltip:
Locks the relative position of the selected components. The components are treated as a single object when moved or when joints are applied.

Select the components to group together.

name: Edit Joint
tooltip:
Position components relative to each other in an assembly, then defines the relative motion between them.

On the Position tab, place a joint origin snap point on each component to position them. On the Motion tab, select the motion Type, then adjust associated settings, add joint limits, and preview joint motion.

name: Edit Rigid Group
tooltip:
Locks the relative position of the selected components. The components are treated as a single object when moved or when joints are applied.

Select the components to group together.

name: Edit Joint
tooltip:
Position components relative to each other in an assembly, then defines the relative motion between them.

On the Position tab, place a joint origin snap point on each component to position them. On the Motion tab, select the motion Type, then adjust associated settings, add joint limits, and preview joint motion.

name: Edit Joint Origin
tooltip:
Positions a joint origin on a component. Joint origins define the geometry used to relate a joint's components.

Select geometry to define the joint origin.

name: Edit Joint Origin
tooltip:
Positions a joint origin on a component. Joint origins define the geometry used to relate a joint's components.

Select geometry to define the joint origin.

name: Edit Constraint
tooltip:
Constrain geometry to position two or more components relative to each other, reduce degrees of freedom in the assembly, and create a Constraint Relationship between the components.

To create a constraint, select faces, edges, or vertexes on two components so they are flush, coincident, concentric, or at an angle. Then specify an offset distance or angle. Optionally, add more constraints to build up a set.

name: As-Built Joint
tooltip:
Creates a Joint relationship between two components in their current position and defines their relative motion.

Select two components to create a joint between, then specify the motion type and the position of the joint origin. Optionally, specify limits and preview motion.

name: As-Built Constraint
tooltip:
Creates a As-Built Constraint relationship between two components in their current position and defines their relative motion.

Select two components to create an assembly constraint between, then position the constraint snap and specify the joint motion type. Optionally, specify motion limits and preview motion.

name: Edit Joint
tooltip:
Creates a Joint relationship between two components in their current position and defines their relative motion.

Select two components to create a joint between, then specify the motion type and the position of the joint origin. Optionally, specify limits and preview motion.

name: Edit Motion Limits
tooltip: Lets you enable, disable, and edit the motion limits associated with this joint.

name: Edit Offset Limits
tooltip: Lets you enable, disable, and edit the offset limits associated with this constraint.

name: Lock Motion
tooltip: Locks this degree of motion and prevents it from moving until you unlock it.

name: Motion Link
tooltip:
Defines rotational and translational relationship between joint degrees of freedom.

Select the joints then specify the values.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Defines rotational and translational relationship between joint degrees of freedom.

Select the joints then specify the values.

name: Constrain Components
tooltip:
Constrain geometry to position two or more components relative to each other, reduce degrees of freedom in the assembly, and create a Constraint Relationship between the components.

To create a constraint, select faces, edges, or vertexes on two components so they are flush, coincident, concentric, or at an angle. Then specify an offset distance or angle. Optionally, add more constraints to build up a set.

name: Align Constraint
tooltip: Aligns selected geometry so they are flush, coincident, or concentric to create an Align Constraint relationship between two components.

name: Angle Constraint
tooltip: Positions selected geometry with a relative angle them to create an Angle Constraint relationship between two components.

name: Center Constraint
tooltip: Positions one component between two faces of another component to create a Center Constraint between them.

name: Tangent Constraint
tooltip: Constrains two components so one selection from the first component maintains tangency with geometry on a second component to create a Tangent Constraint.

name: Joint Constraint
tooltip:
Connects snap points on two components to position them in the assembly, define their relative motion, and create a Joint Constraint between them.

Place the snap point on each component to position them, then select a motion type and adjust associated settings. Optionally, specify motion limits and preview motion.

name: New Component Relationship
tooltip: Create a relationship between components using automatic constraints, manual constraints, or ground to parent.

name: Fluid Volume
tooltip:
Creates the surrounding volume from selected bodies. Surrounding volume can be internal or external to the bodies. The surrounding volume is created in a new component.

Select solid bodies, capping surfaces, or work planes as tools to form the surrounding volume.

name: Select By Boundary
tooltip:
Selects objects using a boundary shape you choose.

Select a body to set the centroid, boundary shape, Selection Type, and whether intersected objects are selected.

name: Mirror
tooltip:
Creates a copy of selected faces, bodies, features, or components, mirrored across a plane.

Select the objects to mirror, then select the mirror plane.

name: Circular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them around a linear axis to create a circular pattern.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the axis to distribute the pattern instances around, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Edit Circular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them around a linear axis to create a circular pattern.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the axis to distribute the pattern instances around, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Pattern on Path
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them to create a pattern along a specific path.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the path to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Edit Pattern on Path
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them to create a pattern along a specific path.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the path to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Edit Pattern on Path
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them to create a pattern along a specific path.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select the path to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Rectangular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select one or more axes to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Edit Rectangular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select one or more axes to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Geometric Pattern
tooltip:
Creates a pattern with size and distribution gradients across a face on a solid body.

Select the face to pattern across, select a solid body as the object to pattern, then adjust the size and distribution settings.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a pattern with size and distribution gradients across a face on a solid body.

Select the face to pattern across, select a solid body as the object to pattern, then adjust the size and distribution settings.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a copy of selected faces, bodies, features, or components, mirrored across a plane.

Select the objects to mirror, then select the mirror plane.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Applies a fixed or parting line draft angle to planar faces.

Select a pull direction, parting tool, and faces to draft, then specify the draft angle.

name: User Coordinate System (UCS)
tooltip:
Creates a custom coordinate system that you can reference in assembly relationships, manufacturing setups or other downstream workflows.

Select a Snap point on a component to place the coordinate system. Optionally, adjust its position, orientation, and axis alignment.

name: Edit User Coordinate System (UCS)
tooltip:
Creates a custom coordinate system that you can reference in assembly relationships, manufacturing setups or other downstream workflows.

Select a Snap point on a component to place the coordinate system. Optionally, adjust its position, orientation, and axis alignment.

name: Arrange
tooltip: Quickly arrange items on a plane or sketch for manufacturing.

name: Edit Arrange
tooltip: Quickly arrange items on a plane or sketch for manufacturing.

name: Bounding Solid
tooltip:
Creates a solid component around a selected component, body, or set of bodies.

Select objects to be enclosed and adjust the shape and size or offset parameters as needed. The resulting bounding solid is a standalone component that can be used for measurements, serve as a reference for the stock volume for manufacturing, or as a base for an outer shell design.

name: Edit Bounding Solid
tooltip:
Creates a solid component around a selected component, body, or set of bodies.

Select objects to be enclosed and adjust the shape and size or offset parameters as needed. The resulting bounding solid is a standalone component that can be used for measurements, serve as a reference for the stock volume for manufacturing, or as a base for an outer shell design.

name: Find Similar Components
tooltip: Finds components in your hub that are similar to those in the active design. You can select similar components and open them or insert them into your design. This is available for solid bodies only.

name: Generate Timeline
tooltip:
AutoTimeline capabilities in this preview may evolve over time, and your feedback helps improve results.

AutoTimeline helps generate a parametric timeline for imported bodies, making them easier to edit and reuse in Fusion.

name: Fit Point Spline
tooltip:
Creates a spline through the selected fit points.

Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as fit points.

name: Control Point Spline
tooltip:
Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.

Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.

name: Control Point Spline
tooltip:
Creates a spline driven by the selected control points.

Select the first point to start the spline. Select additional points as control points.

name: Degree 3
tooltip: Recommended for use in the Sculpt workspace

name: Degree 5
tooltip: Recommended for general modeling workflows

name: SketchPanel
tooltip: Show/Hide sketch panel.

name: Center Diameter Circle
tooltip:
Creates a circle using a center point and diameter.

Select to define the center point then specify the diameter.

name: 2-Point Circle
tooltip:
Creates a circle defined by two points.

Specify two points on the diameter of the circle.

name: 3-Point Circle
tooltip:
Creates a circle defined by three points.

Specify three points on the circumference of the circle. The points define the size and position of the circle.

name: 2-Tangent Circle
tooltip:
Creates a circle tangent to two sketch lines.

Select two lines then specify the radius of the circle.

name: 3-Tangent Circle
tooltip:
Creates a circle tangent to three sketch lines.

Select three lines that the circle will be tangent to.

name: Ellipse
tooltip:
Creates an ellipse defined by a center point, major axis and a point on the ellipse.

Select the center point of the ellipse. Select the second point to define the first axis. Select the third point to define a point on the ellipse.

name: 2-Point Rectangle
tooltip:
Creates a rectangle using two points for the diagonal corners.

Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select the second point or specify the width and height values.

name: 3-Point Rectangle
tooltip:
Creates a rectangle using three points to define width, direction, and height.

Select the first point as the start of the rectangle. Select a second point or specify a distance value and pick a point. Select a third point or specify a distance value.

name: Center Rectangle
tooltip:
Creates a rectangle using two points to define the center and one corner.

Select the first point as the center of the rectangle. Select a corner point or specify width and height values.

name: 3-Point Arc
tooltip:
Creates an arc using three points.

Select the start point, end point, and then a point on the arc.

name: Center Point Arc
tooltip:
Creates an arc using three points.

Select the center point, then select start point and last select the end point or specify an angle value.

name: Tangent Arc
tooltip:
Creates an arc with tangency.

Select two points.

name: Point
tooltip:
Creates an individual sketch point to use as reference geometry.

Click in the canvas to create a point. You can snap to the grid or existing geometry. Use sketch points to define construction geometry, position hole features, space points on a spline, or connect lines in 3D space.

name: Edge Polygon
tooltip:
Creates a polygon by defining a single edge and the position of the polygon.

Select the start and end points of one edge or select the start point then specify a distance and angle. Specify the number of sides. Select a point to define the orientation of the polygon.

name: Inscribed Polygon
tooltip:
Creates a polygon using the center point and a vertex.

Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of edges. Select a vertex point or specify a distance and select a point.

name: Circumscribed Polygon
tooltip:
Creates a polygon using the center point and the midpoint of one edge.

Select the center point of the polygon. Specify a value for the number of sides. Select the midpoint of an edge or specify a distance and select a point.

name: Conic Curve
tooltip:
Creates a curve driven by endpoints and Rho value. Depending on the Rho value, the curve can be elliptical, parabolic, or hyperbolic.

Select the start point, end point, and then the top of the vertex. Use the guidelines to create a tangency constraint. Specify the Rho value for the desired shape of the conic curve.

name: Three Point Arc Slot
tooltip:
Creates an arc slot defined by a three point center arc and slot width.

Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Specify the third point of the center arc, or enter center arc radius. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter or radius of the slot arcs.

name: Center Point Arc Slot
tooltip:
Creates an arc slot defined by a center point, two point center arc and slot width.

Specify the center point of the slot. Specify the start and end point of the slot center arc. Click to specify slot width or enter diameter or radius of the slot arc.

name: Center to Center Slot
tooltip:
Creates a linear slot defined by placement and distance of slot arc centers, and by slot width.

Specify centers of both slot arcs. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

name: Overall Slot
tooltip:
Creates a linear slot defined by orientation, length and width.

Specify the start and end on the slot center line. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

name: Center Point Slot
tooltip:
Creates a linear slot defined by a center point, location of slot arc centers, and by slot width.

Specify the slot center, and place center of a slot arc. Click to specify slot width, or enter diameter of the slot arcs.

name: Fillet
tooltip:
Places an arc of a specified radius at the intersection of two lines or arcs.

Select the vertex or the two lines or arcs. Specify a radius for the fillet.

name: Blend Curve
tooltip:
Creates a tangent or curvature continuous blend curve between the endpoints of two sketch curves or edges.

Select two sketch curves or edges in the canvas to blend.

name: Equal Distance Chamfer
tooltip:
Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on an equal distance to each side.

Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance value for the chamfer.

name: Two Distance Chamfer
tooltip:
Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a different distance to each side.

Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the two distance values for the chamfer.

name: Distance and Angle Chamfer
tooltip:
Creates a chamfer at the vertex, intersection, or apparent intersection of two lines in a sketch, based on a single distance and an angle.

Select a vertex or two lines, then specify the distance and angle values for the chamfer.

name: Trim
tooltip:
Trims a sketch curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.

Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be trimmed. Select the curve to trim.

name: Break
tooltip:
Breaks a sketch entity into two or more segments where it intersects other sketch entities.

Pause the cursor over the sketch entity to preview where it will be broken, then click to break it.

name: Midpoint Line
tooltip:
Creates a line that is symmetrical from the midpoint.

Specify the midpoint to start a line, and click to set the end of the line.

name: Sketch Scale
tooltip:
Scales sketch geometry.

Select sketch geometry to scale, select the point from which to scale, then drag the manipulator handle in the canvas or specify an exact Scale Factor value.

name: Offset
tooltip:
Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.

Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.

name: Extend
tooltip:
Extends a curve to the nearest intersecting curve or boundary geometry.

Pause the cursor over the curve to preview the portion to be extended. Select the curve to extend it.

name: Project To Surface
tooltip: Project sketch geometry, edge, vertex, or workpoint to selected faces.

name: Include 3D Geometry
tooltip:
Include edges, work geometry, and sketch curves into the current sketch.

Select the objects to include.

name: Edit Isoparametric Curve
tooltip:
Creates smooth curves along a face in the U or V direction.

Select to create a single curve or a series of curves, select a face, and specify the curve distribution on the face.

name: Isoparametric Curve
tooltip:
Creates smooth curves along a face in the U or V direction.

Select to create a single curve or a series of curves, select a face, and specify the curve distribution on the face.

name: Mirror
tooltip:
Mirrors the selected sketch curves about a selected sketch line.

Select the curves to mirror then select the line to mirror about.

name: Circular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates selected sketch curves in an arc or circular pattern.

Select the curves to pattern, the point to revolve around, and the quantity.

name: Edit Circular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates selected sketch curves in an arc or circular pattern.

Select the curves to pattern, the point to revolve around, and the quantity.

name: Edit Offset
tooltip:
EDIT : Copies the selected sketch curves a specified distance from the original curves.

EDIT : Select the curves to offset then specify the offset distance.

name: Rectangular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates sketch curves in rows and columns.

Select the curves to pattern then specify the direction, quantity, and distance.

name: Edit Rectangular Pattern
tooltip:
Duplicates faces, bodies, features, or components in a design and distributes them along linear axes in rows and columns to create a rectangular pattern.

Select the object type, then select objects to pattern in the canvas, Browser, or Timeline. Select one or more axes to distribute the pattern instances along, then adjust distribution, quantity, and distance. Check Suppression, then uncheck instances in the canvas to remove them from the pattern.

name: Intersection Curve
tooltip:
Creates a 3D sketch curve from intersecting geometry.

The first selection is the sketch curve. The second selection is the sketch curve or faces to intersect with. You can select multiple curves or faces to intersect with.

name: Project
tooltip:
Projects the body silhouette, edges, work geometries and sketch curves into the active sketch plane.

Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the body silhouette.

name: Intersect
tooltip:
Projects the points, model edges, work geometries, and sketch curves that intersect the active sketch plane.

Use the selection filter to project specific type of geometry or the entire model.

name: Spun Profile
tooltip:
Rotates selected geometry around a specified axis and projects a 2D spun profile on to the active sketch plane.

Use the selection filter to project specific geometry types or the body silhouette.

name: Sketch Dimension
tooltip:
Create sketch dimensions for sketch geometries. Use dimensions to control the size or position of sketch objects.

Select the sketch curves to dimension then select an area to position the dimension.

name: Constraints
tooltip: Constraints dictate the position of geometry relative to other sketch geometries.

name: Coincident
tooltip:
Constrains the position of two points or a point and a line or curve together.

This could be a point constrained along a line, two points constrainted to each other, or a point constrained along a curve.

name: Collinear
tooltip:
Constrains two or more objects so that they share a common line.

This could be a line and a rectangle, where the line and one edge of the rectangle lie along the same line.

name: Concentric
tooltip: Constrains two or more arcs, circles, or ellipses to the same center point.

name: MidPoint
tooltip: Constrains a point or object to the midpoint of another object.

name: Fix/UnFix
tooltip: Locks the size and location of a point or object.

name: Parallel
tooltip: Constrains two lines so that they extend in the same direction and never intersect.

name: Perpendicular
tooltip: Constrains two objects so that they lie perpendicular (at a 90-degree angle) to each other.

name: Horizontal/Vertical
tooltip: Constrains a single line, or two points, to lie on either the vertical or horizontal axis, whichever is closer to the current alignment.

name: Tangent
tooltip: Constrains a curve and another object so that they touch at a single point but never cross each other.

name: Equal
tooltip: Constrains similar objects so that their sizes are identical. When the size of one object changes, the others adjust, too.

name: Symmetry
tooltip: Constrains two or more objects so that they are symmetrical (identical to each other in relation to a common axis).

name: Curvature
tooltip: Constrains two or more objects to create a smooth, continuous curvature between them (G2 continuity).

name: Polygon
tooltip: Constrains a closed sketch profile with sides of the same length and equal angles as a regular polygon.

name: Insert SVG
tooltip:
Imports an SVG file into the active sketch.

Use SVG files for vector artwork such as logos or custom text.

name: Text
tooltip:
Creates text inside a rectangular frame or along a selected path, which you can use as a profile to create 3D geometry.

Place the text frame or select the path for text to follow, then enter and format your text.

name: Edit Text
tooltip:
Creates text inside a rectangular frame or along a selected path, which you can use as a profile to create 3D geometry.

Place the text frame or select the path for text to follow, then enter and format your text.

name: Move
tooltip:
Moves the selected sketch curve. Curves can be moved off the sketch plane to create a 3D sketch.

Select the curves to move then specify the new location.

name: Press Pull
tooltip: Modifies the selected geometry using offset, extrude, or fillet commands. The operation depends on the geometry selected.

name: Select By Size
tooltip:
Selects bodies or components within a size range that you specify.

Use the slider controls or specify the minimum and maximum size values. The size value is the distance between the opposing diagonal corners of the body or component bounding box.

name: Seed And Boundary
tooltip:
Automatically creates a selection set that includes faces on a solid or surface body that are located between a set of boundary objects and a seed object.

Select faces or edges on a solid or surface body to define the selection boundary, then select a face on the body to use as the seed object for the selection set. Click Update to refresh the selection set based on the current boundary and seed objects.

name: Find Features
tooltip:
Identifies features in a body. Recognized features are listed in the browser.

Select the bodies then specify the feature types to identify.

name: Remove Faces
tooltip:
Deletes selected faces.

Select faces to remove. Neighboring faces are automatically deleted, as appropriate, in order to heal the model.

name: Remove Features
tooltip:
Automatically deletes features from selected objects.

Select objects, from which to delete features, and choose appropriate settings. Associated features are selected and deleted accordingly.

name: Edit Remove Features
tooltip:
Automatically deletes features from selected objects.

Select objects, from which to delete features, and choose appropriate settings. Associated features are selected and deleted accordingly.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Replaces selected objects with primitive shapes.

Choose appropriate objects and define the replacement shape. The default primitive shape bounds all selected objects and the original objects are suppressed.

name: Replace with Primitives
tooltip:
Replaces selected objects with primitive shapes.

Choose appropriate objects and define the replacement shape. The default primitive shape bounds all selected objects and the original objects are suppressed.

name: Convert
tooltip:
Changes the body type of the selected object. Converts BRep (solid or surface) faces to a T-Spline face. Converts a T-Spline body to a BRep body. Converts a quad mesh to a T-Spline body.

Select the object to convert.

name: Point At Vertex
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at an existing point or vertex.

Select a vertex or sketch point to place the Construction Point.

name: Point Through Three Planes
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of three non-parallel planes or faces.

Select three planes, faces, or sketch profiles to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Point At Edge And Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection of a linear edge, sketch line, or axis with a face or plane.

Select a linear edge, sketch line, or axis and a face or plane to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Point Through Two Edges
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of two edges.

Select two edges or sketch lines to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Point Along Path
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at a specific distance along the path.

Select an edge, sketch line, or curve to use as the path to create the Construction Point along. Optionally, specify a distance to place the point.

name: Point At Center Of Circle/Sphere/Torus
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the center of a circle, sphere, or torus.

Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face, or toroidal face to create a Construction Point at its center.

name: Offset Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is offset from the selected face or plane.

Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance.

name: Midplane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane at the midpoint between two faces or planes.

Select two faces or planes to create a Construction Plane between them.

name: Tangent Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is tangent to a face.

Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.

name: Plane Through Two Edges
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that passes through two edges or axes.

Select two linear edges, axes or sketch lines to create a Construction Plane through.

name: Plane Through Three Points
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that passes through three points or vertices.

Select three points or vertices to create a Construction Plane through.

name: Plane at Angle
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane through an edge, axis, or line at a specific angle.

Select a linear edge, axis, or sketch line to position the plane, then specify the rotation angle.

name: Plane Along Path
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane normal to an edge or sketch line.

Select an edge or sketch line to create a Construction Plane along.

name: Perpendicular Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is perpendicular to a plane or face.

Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face. Optionally, select a point or face to refine location.

name: Axis Through Cylinder/Cone/Torus
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis through the center of a cylinder, cone or torus.

Select a cylinder, cone, or torus to create an axis through its center.

name: Axis Through Edge
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis along a linear edge or sketch curve.

Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line to place the axis.

name: Axis Through Two Planes
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis coincident with the intersection of two faces or planes.

Select two faces or planes to create an axis where they intersect.

name: Axis Perpendicular To Face
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis that is perpendicular to a face and passes through a specific point.

Select a face or plane and a vertex or sketch point to create an axis that is perpendicular to the plane and coincident with the point.

name: Axis Through Two Points
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis that passes through two points or vertices.

Select two vertices or sketch points to create a Construction Axis that is coincident with both vertices and points.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at an existing point or vertex.

Select a vertex or sketch point to place the Construction Point.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of three non-parallel planes or faces.

Select three planes, faces, or sketch profiles to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection of a linear edge, sketch line, or axis with a face or plane.

Select a linear edge, sketch line, or axis and a face or plane to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the intersection or extended intersection of two edges.

Select two edges or sketch lines to create a Construction Point where they intersect.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at a specific distance along the path.

Select an edge, sketch line, or curve to use as the path to create the Construction Point along. Optionally, specify a distance to place the point.

name: Edit Construction Point
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Point at the center of a circle, sphere, or torus.

Select a circular face or sketch profile, spherical face, or toroidal face to create a Construction Point at its center.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is offset from the selected face or plane.

Select a face, plane or sketch profile, then specify the offset distance.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane at the midpoint between two faces or planes.

Select two faces or planes to create a Construction Plane between them.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is tangent to a face.

Select a face to create a plane tangent to, then select a reference point or face or plane (when cylindrical face is selected) to align to or adjust the angle to rotate the plane around face.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that passes through two edges or axes.

Select two linear edges, axes or sketch lines to create a Construction Plane through.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that passes through three points or vertices.

Select three points or vertices to create a Construction Plane through.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane through an edge, axis, or line at a specific angle.

Select a linear edge, axis, or sketch line to position the plane, then specify the rotation angle.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane normal to an edge or sketch line.

Select an edge or sketch line to create a Construction Plane along.

name: Edit Construction Plane
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Plane that is perpendicular to a plane or face.

Select a plane or face to create a construction plane that is perpendicular to the plane or face. Optionally, select a point or face to refine location.

name: Edit Construction Axis
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis through the center of a cylinder, cone or torus.

Select a cylinder, cone, or torus to create an axis through its center.

name: Edit Construction Axis
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis along a linear edge or sketch curve.

Select a linear edge, axis or sketch line to place the axis.

name: Edit Construction Axis
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis coincident with the intersection of two faces or planes.

Select two faces or planes to create an axis where they intersect.

name: Edit Construction Axis
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis that is perpendicular to a face and passes through a specific point.

Select a face or plane and a vertex or sketch point to create an axis that is perpendicular to the plane and coincident with the point.

name: Edit Construction Axis
tooltip:
Creates a Construction Axis that passes through two points or vertices.

Select two vertices or sketch points to create a Construction Axis that is coincident with both vertices and points.

name: New Component
tooltip:
Creates a new internal or external component in the assembly.

Select type and parent, then name the component. For external components, select location. For internal components, you can select bodies to create a component for each.

name: Add To Assembly
tooltip:
Inserts the active design into an Assembly Design as an external component.

Select an Assembly Design to insert into, then use the manipulators in the canvas or Initial Position dialog to place the component in the target design.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a new internal or external component in the assembly.

Select type and parent, then name the component. For external components, select location. For internal components, you can select bodies to create a component for each.

name: Save As OBJ
tooltip: Select a mesh body to save as OBJ

name: Save Control Frame as OBJ
tooltip: Select a T-Spline body to save control frame as OBJ

name: Save T-Spline as IGA
tooltip: Select a T-Spline body to save as IGA

name: Non-associative
tooltip: Only allows local edits. Does not create associative references between this external component and other components in the assembly.

name: Associative
tooltip: Creates associative references between this external component and other components in the assembly.

name: Reference Objects
tooltip:
Creates associative references between the
current design and other components, bodies,
sketches, and construction geometry in an
assembly.

name: Visibility Control
tooltip:
Control component visibility and transparency during Edit In Place sessions.

Adjust transparency sliders, visual style, and color overrides to better visualize your design during editing.

name: Background Canvas
tooltip:
Places an image in the 3D space. The image will be placed in the center of current view and is oriented relative to the active camera.

Select an image to import then position and scale the image.

name: Canvas
tooltip:
Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane.

Select a face then select an image to import.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane.

Select a face then select an image to import.

name: Edit Canvas
tooltip:
Places an image on a planar face or sketch plane.

Select a face then select an image to import.

name: Decal
tooltip:
Places an image on a selected face as a cosmetic decal.

Select a PNG, JPG, or TIF image file from a Fusion project or your local computer. Select a face on a solid or surface body to apply it to, then adjust its orientation, scale, and opacity.

name: Light
tooltip:
Adds light to control illumination, shadows, and highlights in your render.

Combine scene lights with environment lighting in Scene Settings for realistic results. You can add up to eight lights per design.

name: Display Component Colors
tooltip:
Displays each component in an assembly as a different color to make them easier to differentiate. Hides physical materials and appearances.

Press Shift+N to show or hide component colors in the canvas. Right-click a component and select Cycle Component Color to change its color.

name: Display Mesh Face Groups
tooltip:
Display face groups on mesh bodies to make them easier to work with. Hides component colors, physical materials and appearances.

Press Shift+F to show or hide mesh face groups

name: Open tasks in web
tooltip:
Opens all tasks in your default web browser.

View and manage all your assigned tasks in the web interface.

name: Create new task
tooltip:
Creates a new task in the task management system.

Opens a dialog to create and assign a new task.

name: Related tasks
tooltip:
Shows tasks related to the current item or selection.

View and manage tasks that are associated with the current context.

name: Link document
tooltip:
Select a Fusion design or drawing to link to the task.

Supports .f3d and .f2d files from your hub projects.

name: Curvature Comb Analysis
tooltip:
Displays a comb with sample points along selected edges of a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

Select edges to analyze on a body, then adjust the density and scale of the curvature comb.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays a comb with sample points along selected edges of a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

Select edges to analyze on a body, then adjust the density and scale of the curvature comb.

name: Zebra Analysis
tooltip:
Displays alternating black and white stripes on a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

Select bodies to analyze, then adjust the direction, repeats, and opacity of the zebra stripes.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays alternating black and white stripes on a body to help you analyze the curvature of a surface.

Select bodies to analyze, then adjust the direction, repeats, and opacity of the zebra stripes.

name: Draft Analysis
tooltip:
Displays a color gradient on the faces of selected bodies to help evaluate the manufacturability of your design.

Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays a color gradient on the faces of selected bodies to help evaluate the manufacturability of your design.

Select the bodies to evaluate and the axis to define the direction. Use the options to refine the gradient display.

name: Curvature Map Analysis
tooltip:
Displays a color gradient on bodies to help you analyze areas of high and low surface curvature.

Select bodies to analyze, then select a curvature map type and adjust the display settings of the curvature map.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays a color gradient on bodies to help you analyze areas of high and low surface curvature.

Select bodies to analyze, then select a curvature map type and adjust the display settings of the curvature map.

name: Accessibility Analysis
tooltip:
Used to colorize an object based on whether or not certain parts of the object are accessible from a particular plane.

Inaccessible areas are highlighted in red. Useful for checking undercut areas through a plane.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Used to colorize an object based on whether or not certain parts of the object are accessible from a particular plane.

Inaccessible areas are highlighted in red. Useful for checking undercut areas through a plane.

name: Minimum Radius Analysis
tooltip:
Displays colors on the model that represent the minimum radius for the curvature of the concave faces.

Detect the minimum fit for holes and fillets. Useful for determining tool sizes in machining.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays colors on the model that represent the minimum radius for the curvature of the concave faces.

Detect the minimum fit for holes and fillets. Useful for determining tool sizes in machining.

name: Isocurve Analysis
tooltip:
Applies UV mapping and curvature combs to analyze the quality of a surface.

Select bodies or faces to analyze, select the isocurve type, then adjust the number of isocurves to display. You can also display curvature combs and control their density and scale.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Applies UV mapping and curvature combs to analyze the quality of a surface.

Select bodies or faces to analyze, select the isocurve type, then adjust the number of isocurves to display. You can also display curvature combs and control their density and scale.

name: Section Analysis
tooltip:
Creates a view that cuts through all visible objects in a design to reveal interior details and obscured features.

Select a planar object to define the cut plane, then adjust the distance and angles to position it in the design. In the Browser, the Section Analysis displays in the Analysis folder, where you can adjust its visibility, edit it, or delete it.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Creates a view that cuts through all visible objects in a design to reveal interior details and obscured features.

Select a planar object to define the cut plane, then adjust the distance and angles to position it in the design. In the Browser, the Section Analysis displays in the Analysis folder, where you can adjust its visibility, edit it, or delete it.

name: Environment Map Analysis
tooltip:
Applies environment map analysis to selected bodies.

Select bodies, choose an environment, then adjust rotate, opacity, and quality options.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Applies environment map analysis to selected bodies.

Select bodies, choose an environment, then adjust rotate, opacity, and quality options.

name: Center of Mass
tooltip:
Displays a center mark glyph at the center of mass for the selected objects.

You can measure from the center mark to other objects.

name: DOF Analysis
tooltip: Displays Degree of Freedom of each component in the Assembly.

name: Assembly Statistics
tooltip: Displays Assembly Statistics of the Assembly.

name: Edit
tooltip:
Displays a center mark glyph at the center of mass for the selected objects.

You can measure from the center mark to other objects.

name: Fastener Stack Analysis
tooltip:
Displays fastener stacks and their status with respect to engagement settings.

Fastener stacks are recognized based on relative spatial placement of fasteners.

name: Navigator
tooltip:
Shows how data elements connect in a visual graph.

Double click any subassembly node to explore its connected data.

name: Edit Fastener Stack Analysis
tooltip:
Displays fastener stacks and their status with respect to engagement settings.

Fastener stacks are recognized based on relative spatial placement of fasteners.
