name: Window Selection
tooltip:
Selects objects enclosed in a rectangular selection area.

Click and drag from left to right (window selection) to select objects enclosed by the selection boundary. Click and drag from right to left (crossing selection) to select all visible objects the selection boundary intersects and encloses.

Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

name: Freeform Selection
tooltip:
Selects objects enclosed in an irregular (lasso) selection area.

A clockwise boundary shape selects all objects within the boundary. A counterclockwise boundary shape selects all visible objects crossed by the boundary.

Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

name: Paint Selection
tooltip:
Press and hold the left mouse button and move across objects to select them.

Use Selection Filters to include or exclude objects by type.

name: Select Adjacent Faces
tooltip: Selects faces adjacent to the selected object.

name: History
tooltip:
Displays the version history of the selected component.

Select a component to view its version history and optionally choose a different version.

name: Advance to Latest
tooltip: Advances all components in the assembly with their latest changes, even if those changes are not versions.

name: Invert Selection
tooltip:
Switches the selection state of all objects.

Selection is based on the active selection filter and selection mode.

name: Insert McMaster-Carr Component
tooltip:
Insert a McMaster-Carr Component into the active document.

Browse to the desired component, click the Product Detail CAD icon, select the file type, then click Save.

name: Insert DXF
tooltip:
Inserts geometry from a DXF file into the active sketch.

Select a face or plane, select the DXF file to insert, then position the geometry on the plane.

Select the unit type that matches the units from the original design that generated the DXF.

name: Read-Only For Me
tooltip:
Current Status: Savable

Click to make the design temporarily read-only for you.
Other project members can reserve the design.

name: Read-Only For Me
tooltip:
Current Status: Read-Only

Click to make the design savable again.
You can reserve the design and save pending changes.

name: Select By Name
tooltip:
Selects bodies or components by the name used in the Browser.

Enter a portion of the object name, check the object types to include, then click Find. You can search using one or more characters or words, finding only objects having that string in the name.

name: Insert Derive
tooltip:
Pulls and links design features from another design into the active design. When you update the derived features in the original design, the changes are reflected in the destination design.

Before you start, activate the component that you want to contain the derived design features. Select a design, then select a set of components, bodies, sketches, construction geometry, flat patterns, or parameters to derive into the current design.

name: Save Migrated Documents
tooltip:
Saves main assembly and all opened and migrated external reference (xRef) files and updates their references to point to new versions.

The command uses a two-phase approach: first saves all xRef assets to create new versions, then updates all references in the assembly to point to the new versions. This ensures consistency between saved versions and references.

name: Edit Derive Feature
tooltip:
Pulls and links design features from another design into the active design. When you update the derived features in the original design, the changes are reflected in the destination design.

Before you start, activate the component that you want to contain the derived design features. Select a design, then select a set of components, bodies, sketches, construction geometry, flat patterns, or parameters to derive into the current design.

name: Derive
tooltip:
Pushes and links design features from the active design into a new or existing design. When you update the derived features in the original design, the changes are reflected in the destination design.

Select a single component or a set of components, bodies, sketches, construction geometry, flat patterns, or parameters to derive from the active design.

name: Open...
tooltip:
Opens a design or drawing from your projects or local computer.

Select a design or drawing from the project browser and click Open, or click “Open from my computer” and select a supported file.

name: AutoConstrain
tooltip: Generates options using AI technology to automatically dimension and constrain your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.

name: AutoConstrain from datum
tooltip: Place a datum point to align the constraints and dimensions to, then AI technology automatically generates options with dimension and constraints added your sketch. Review the proposals and select the one that best suits your needs.

name: Replace Component
tooltip:
Replaces an external component in an assembly with a different external design.

In the dialog, navigate to and select a different external design. Check Replace All Instances if you want to replace all identical instances of the selected component in the assembly.

name: Sketch Constrainer
tooltip:
Sketch Constrainer command.

Select a sketch entity to apply constraints automatically.

name: Change Summary
tooltip:
Displays a list of changes made to the current assembly and its external references.

Select a component to highlight it in the canvas.

name: Hole/Thread Note
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) note for a hole or boss, with or without threads.

Add a leader line and include units, diameter, depth, thread information, tolerance, and text. The information stays with the feature and can be reused in downstream manufacturing workflows, such as automated hole drilling.

name: Edit PMI
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) note for a hole or boss, with or without threads.

Add a leader line and include units, diameter, depth, thread information, tolerance, and text. The information stays with the feature and can be reused in downstream manufacturing workflows, such as automated hole drilling.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) note for a hole or boss, with or without threads.

Add a leader line and include units, diameter, depth, thread information, tolerance, and text. The information stays with the feature and can be reused in downstream manufacturing workflows, such as automated hole drilling.

name: Note
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) general note.

Add a leader line and include general information, such as instructions, references to standards, or clarifications.

name: Edit PMI
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) general note.

Add a leader line and include general information, such as instructions, references to standards, or clarifications.

name: Edit Annotation
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) general note.

Add a leader line and include general information, such as instructions, references to standards, or clarifications.

name: Sizes and Dimensions
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) for dimensions.

Add linear, angular, radius, or diameter dimensions to the model.

name: Edit PMI
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) for dimensions.

Add linear, angular, radius, or diameter dimensions to the model.

name: Edit Annotation
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) for dimensions.

Add linear, angular, radius, or diameter dimensions to the model.

name: Geometric Tolerancing
tooltip:
Creates a product manufacturing information (PMI) geometric tolerance annotation.

Add geometric tolerancing feature control frames and datum icons to annotate geometric tolerances on model geometry.

name: Insert T-Spline
tooltip:
Inserts a T-Spline Mesh (TSM) file as a single T-Spline body or a T-Spline Scene (TSS) file as one or more T-Spline bodies.

Select the TSM or TSS file you want to insert, then click Open. The T-Spline bodies display in the canvas and Browser and you can use the Form tools to edit them.

name: Edit Form
tooltip:
Manipulates faces, edges and vertices with transform, scale and rotate editing.

Select faces, edges, or vertices to enable the manipulator. Double click a face or edge to select a loop.

name: Extrude
tooltip:
Creates or modifies a T-Spline body by adding faces along a vector.

Select sketch curves, profiles or faces. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the distance and number of faces.

name: Revolve
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline body by revolving edges or sketch geometry around a selected axis.

Select sketch curves, profiles, planar faces, or edges then select the axis to revolve around. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the number of faces.

name: Sweep
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline body by sweeping edges or sketch curves along a selected path.

Select sketch curves or profiles then select the path to sweep along. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify percentage length of the path and the number of faces.

name: Insert Edge
tooltip:
Inserts edges at a specified position from the original edge.

Select an edge or double click to select a loop.

name: Slide Edge
tooltip:
Moves the selected edge along the control polygon.

Select the edges then specify the new position.

name: Bevel Edge
tooltip:
Creates a bevel on a T-spline body along selected edges.

Select the edges and specify the distance to offset the new edges, then specify the number of segments to insert, spacing method, and crown value.

name: Insert Point
tooltip:
Inserts an edge by selecting two points.

Select a point on an edge to start. Continue selecting points on additional edges to divide multiple faces.

name: Thicken
tooltip:
Creates a body offset.

Select the body then set the thickness and end treatments.

name: Weld Vertices
tooltip:
Joins two or more vertices.

Select two vertices to join. Window select vertices to weld within the specified tolerance.

name: UnWeld Edges
tooltip:
Disconnects an edge or loop.

Select an edge or double click to select a loop. Hold Ctrl (Windows) or Command (Mac) to select multiple edges.

name: Plane
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline plane.

Select a plane and draw a rectangle. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the height and number of faces.

name: Box
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline box.

Select a plane and draw a rectangle. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the height and number of faces.

name: Cylinder
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline cylinder.

Select a plane and draw a circle. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the height and number of faces.

name: Sphere
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline sphere.

Select a plane then a center point for the sphere. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the diameter and number of faces.

name: Quadball
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline quadball.

Select a plane then a center point for the sphere. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify the diameter and number of faces.

name: Torus
tooltip:
Creates a T-Spline torus.

Select a plane and draw a circle. Use the manipulators or input fields to specify major and minor diameters and the number of faces.

name: Mirror - Internal
tooltip:
Creates a mirror symmetry with the elements of a T-Spline body.

Select a face on each side of the body. If needed select edges on each side, then vertices.

name: Circular - Internal
tooltip:
Creates circular symmetry with the elements of a T-Spline body.

Select a face on the body then select the number of symmetry lines.

name: Mirror - Duplicate
tooltip:
Create a duplicate body mirrored across a specified plane.

Select the body to copy then select the mirror plane.

name: Circular - Duplicate
tooltip:
Create specified number of duplicate bodies around a selected axis.

Select the body to copy then select the axis to revolve around.

name: Clear Symmetry
tooltip:
Remove symmetry constraint from individual bodies or a series of bodies.

Select the symmetric bodies.

name: Face
tooltip:
Creates individual T-Spline faces.

Select a plane to begin defining vertices or select vertices from a T-Spline body.

name: Display Mode
tooltip:
Sets the body display to smooth, box, or control frame. Smooth shows the actual model. Box displays only the control framework. Control frame displays the framework and the actual model.

Select the desired display mode. If there is more than one T-Spline body, you need to select the body to change the display.

name: Enable Better Performance
tooltip: Toggles between better performance or better display. Better display shows the bodies at highest quality (G1 conditions at star points). Better performance calculates modification by applying G0 conditions at star points.

name: Fill Hole
tooltip:
Fills an internal hole in T-Spline body.

Select the edge of the hole and set the fill type.

name: Erase And Fill
tooltip:
Deletes a part of connected T-Spline geometry and fills new gaps with faces. You can use this to remove struts or bridges.

Select the faces to erase and select fill type.

name: Subdivide
tooltip:
Divides one or more faces into a subset of faces.

Select T-Spline faces to divide, then select the Insert Mode and adjust the number of faces to divide selected faces into. Optionally for Simple Mode, check Object Snap and specify the Offset distance.

name: Smooth
tooltip:
Smoothes an area of the T-Spline geometry.

Select the faces to smooth and the smoothing rate.

name: Cylindrify
tooltip:
Forms uneven T-Spline geometry into a smooth cylindrical shape.

Select a face on the feature to cylindrify. The preview displays automatically. Uncheck Auto Feature Selection to select individual faces.

name: Make Uniform
tooltip:
Evenly distributes the angles at the intersection of star points and makes faces as uniform as possible.

Select a T-Spline body to make uniform.

name: Crease
tooltip:
Creates a sharp edge between faces.

Select edges to crease.

name: UnCrease
tooltip:
Restores previously creased edges to their original state.

Select creased edges to uncrease.

name: Bridge
tooltip:
Creates segments to connect two opposing faces within a body or between two bodies.

Select the first set of edges then select the second set of edges.

name: Merge Edge
tooltip:
Aligns the first set of selected edges to a second set of selected edges.

Select the first set of edges then the second set of edges.

name: Flatten
tooltip:
Projects vertices to a best fit or user defined plane.

Select the vertices and/or tangency handles to flatten.

name: Straighten
tooltip:
Straightens vertices to a best fit line, an existing line, or a line through two selected points.

Select the direction type, select a line or two points to define the line, then select the vertices or tangency handles to straighten.

name: Edit By Curve
tooltip:
Manipulates T-Spline edges using a driving curve.

Select edges to create a driving curve. Move the control points to adjust the shape of the T-Spline edges.

name: Pull
tooltip:
Snaps selected T-Spline vertices to a face or surface. The vertices could be control points or surface points.

Select the vertices to move and the vertices will automatically move to the nearest body.

name: Interpolate
tooltip:
Switches the location of the surface and the control points to improve fitting. Select whether to move the control points to the surface or the surface to the control points.

Select the body then set whether you are moving control points or surface points.

name: Repair Body
tooltip:
Analyzes the T-Spline body and displays information about the mesh. Corrects Error T and Error Star conditions.

Select the body to analyze.

name: Match
tooltip:
Aligns the edges of a T-Spline body with sketch curves or edges on a solid or surface body.

Select the T-Spline edges, then select the sketch curves or edges on a solid or surface body to match.

name: Edit Match
tooltip:
Aligns the edges of a T-Spline body with sketch curves or edges on a solid or surface body.

Select the T-Spline edges, then select the sketch curves or edges on a solid or surface body to match.

name: Pipe
tooltip:
Manages the creation of complex topologies base on selected curves. Paths can be sketch geometry and edges of bodies.

Select the input path, specify the global diameter then modify sections, paths, and the number of faces.

name: Edit Pipe
tooltip:
Manages the creation of complex topologies base on selected curves. Paths can be sketch geometry and edges of bodies.

Select the input path, specify the global diameter then modify sections, paths, and the number of faces.

name: Isolate Symmetry
tooltip:
Prevents symmetric transformations from being applied to the selected vertex, edge or face.

Select the faces, edges, or vertices to remove symmetry from.

name: Freeze
tooltip:
Freezes faces and edges on the model to prevent accidental changes.

Select faces or edges to freeze.

name: UnFreeze
tooltip:
Unfreezes faces and edges that have previously been frozen.

Select faces or edges to unfreeze.

name: Copy Working Model, activate it and import gemetry
Finish Simplify
tooltip: Click Finish Simplify to return to the Simulation workspace.

name: Finish Edit Model
tooltip: Enables you to return to the Generative Design workspace.

name: Simulate in CFD
tooltip:
Launches your model in Autodesk CFD.

Opens CFD and imports your model into a new file. Setup and run your CFD simulation using your verified geometry.

name: CFD Model Assessment Tool
tooltip:
Open in CFD Model Assessment Tool.

Opens Autodesk CFD and imports your model into the Assessment Tool before creating a new Design Study.

name: Simulate in Moldflow Adviser
tooltip:
Launches your model in Autodesk Moldflow Adviser.

Opens Moldflow Adviser and imports your model into a new file. Setup and run your Moldflow simulation using your verified geometry.

name: Simulate in Moldflow Insight
tooltip:
Launches your model in Autodesk Moldflow Insight.

Opens Moldflow Synergy and imports your model into a new file. Setup and run your Moldflow simulation using your verified geometry.

name: Sheet Metal Rules
tooltip:
Rules control the thickness, bend radius, reliefs, and other settings related to sheet metal design.

Create and edit rules in the active document to change your designs. Save rules to the library to make them accessible in other designs.

name: Sheet Metal Rules Library
tooltip:
Manage and reuse sheet metal rules across designs.

Create, edit, and save rules in the library to make them accessible in other designs.

name: Flange (Base/Edge/Contour)
tooltip:
Use different flange types to create various sheet metal forms:

Base Flange creates flat sheet metal face.
Edge Flange creates bend and face on the edge of existing sheet metal face.
Contour Flange constructs multiple bends and faces based on open sketch profile.

name: Hem
tooltip:
Folds sheet metal edge back onto itself.

You can create the following hems: Open, Flat, Double, Rolled, Teardrop, and Rope.

name: Lofted Flange
tooltip:
Creates a sheet metal flange that transitions between two sketch profiles.

Commonly used in duct fabrication.

name: Edit Flange
tooltip:
Use different flange types to create various sheet metal forms:

Base Flange creates flat sheet metal face.
Edge Flange creates bend and face on the edge of existing sheet metal face.
Contour Flange constructs multiple bends and faces based on open sketch profile.

name: Corner Closure
tooltip: Adjusts the gap and relief shape of a corner that is formed by two flanges.

name: Edit Corner Closure
tooltip: Adjusts the gap and relief shape of a corner that is formed by two flanges.

name: Join by bend
tooltip:
Joins two separate sheet metal bodies by creating a connecting bend.

Material may be added to one or both bodies to connect them.

name: Edit Join by bend
tooltip:
Joins two separate sheet metal bodies by creating a connecting bend.

Material may be added to one or both bodies to connect them.

name: Sheet Metal Fillet
tooltip:
Rounds thickness edges of sheet metal flanges by a specified radius.

Fillets remove sharp corners and can help distribute stress at corners, and improve coating or finishing by allowing more uniform coverage along edges.

name: Edit Sheet Metal Fillet
tooltip:
Rounds thickness edges of sheet metal flanges by a specified radius.

Fillets remove sharp corners and can help distribute stress at corners, and improve coating or finishing by allowing more uniform coverage along edges.

name: Sheet Metal Chamfer
tooltip:
Bevels thickness edges of sheet metal flanges by a specified distance.

Chamfers remove sharp corners to improve safety, reduce edge stress, and help sheet metal parts fit and assemble more easily with other components.

name: Edit Sheet Metal Chamfer
tooltip:
Bevels thickness edges of sheet metal flanges by a specified distance.

Chamfers remove sharp corners to improve safety, reduce edge stress, and help sheet metal parts fit and assemble more easily with other components.

name: Fold
tooltip:
Bends the sheet metal model along the selected sketch lines with one face fixed.

Angle, position, and relief options control how the sheet metal is folded.

name: Edit Fold
tooltip:
Bends the sheet metal model along the selected sketch lines with one face fixed.

Angle, position, and relief options control how the sheet metal is folded.

name: Convert to Sheet Metal
tooltip:
Converts a solid body of uniform thickness to a sheet metal body.

Select a face of a solid body for inferring thickness.

name: Convert to Sheet Metal
tooltip:
Converts a solid body of uniform thickness to a sheet metal body.

Select a face of a solid body for inferring thickness.

name: Edit Convert to sheet metal
tooltip:
Converts a solid body of uniform thickness to a sheet metal body.

Select a face of a solid body for inferring thickness.

name: Switch Sheet Metal Rule
tooltip: Displays sheetmetal rule data.

name: Unfold
tooltip:
Flattens selected bends with one face fixed so you can add features across flanges.

Any changes made in the flat state remain in the folded model.

name: Edit Unfold
tooltip:
Flattens selected bends with one face fixed so you can add features across flanges.

Any changes made in the flat state remain in the folded model.

name: Refold
tooltip:
Returns the model to its folded shape.

Any changes made in the flat state remain in the folded model.

name: Create Flat Pattern
tooltip:
Enters Flat Pattern mode and creates a flat pattern from a folded design.

Select the face to position on the XY plane. All flanges are unfolded from that face. Select Finish Flat Pattern to exit out of the mode.

name: Finish Flat Pattern
tooltip: Return to the folded model.

name: Export Flat Pattern
tooltip:
Exports a sheet metal flat pattern to a DXF or STEP file.

DXF exports assign profiles, bend lines, and text to layers. STEP exports the flat pattern as 3D geometry with bend lines in sketch.

name: Rip
tooltip:
Creates a Rip on a sheet metal flange along an edge, between two points, or removes a face.

Select a face to remove, an edge to rip along, or two points to define the start and end of the rip. If selecting two points or an edge, specify the Gap Width value.

name: Cosmetic bend
tooltip: Create lines that represent bends or creases in the flat pattern and drawing, without changing the folded model.

name: Edit cosmetic bend
tooltip: Create lines that represent bends or creases in the flat pattern and drawing, without changing the folded model.

name: Patch
tooltip:
Creates a planar or 3D surface within the boundary of a specified closed loop.

Select the loop to patch then apply connected (G0), tangent (G1), and curvature (G2) boundary conditions.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a planar or 3D surface within the boundary of a specified closed loop.

Select the loop to patch then apply connected (G0), tangent (G1), and curvature (G2) boundary conditions.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a new surface body at a given distance from the selected face or surface body.

Select a face or surface body to offset, then specify the distance.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a new offset shell at a given distance from the selected face.

Select the face to offset then specify the distance.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a new midsurface shell from the selected body.

Select the face to midsurface.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a new surface shell from the surface.

Select the surface to surface shell.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Flips the positive direction of all faces on a selected surface body.

Select a surface body to reverse.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Removes the selected area of a surface body using the specified cutting tool.

Select the cutting tool to use then select faces or surface bodies to remove.

name: Merge
tooltip:
Combines the selected faces into a single quilt surface.

Select the faces to merge. You can select solid or surface faces.

name: Reverse Normal
tooltip:
Flips the positive direction of all faces on a selected surface body.

Select a surface body to reverse.

name: Trim
tooltip:
Removes the selected area of a surface body using the specified cutting tool.

Select the cutting tool to use then select faces or surface bodies to remove.

name: Stitch
tooltip:
Joins surfaces to make a single surface body or solid body.

Select the surfaces to join. Edges within the tolerance are highlighted green.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Joins surfaces to make a single surface body or solid body.

Select the surfaces to join. Edges within the tolerance are highlighted green.

name: Unstitch
tooltip:
Breaks joined surfaces into individual surfaces.

Select faces to unstitch. The selected face is unhooked from the parent body and the result body contains the unhooked face.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Breaks joined surfaces into individual surfaces.

Select faces to unstitch. The selected face is unhooked from the parent body and the result body contains the unhooked face.

name: Offset
tooltip:
Creates a new surface body at a given distance from the selected face or surface body.

Select a face or surface body to offset, then specify the distance.

name: Ruled
tooltip:
Creates a ruled surface at a specified distance and angle from selected edges.

Select edges on a solid body, surface body, or sketch. Then select a ruled surface type and specify the direction, distance, and angle.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a ruled surface at a specified distance and angle from selected edges.

Select edges on a solid body, surface body, or sketch. Then select a ruled surface type and specify the direction, distance, and angle.

name: Untrim
tooltip:
Extends trimmed surfaces and fills gaps, holes, or empty regions.

Select the surface to untrim, then select the untrim type. You can untrim all edges, internal edges, external edges, or manually select the edges you want to untrim.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Extends trimmed surfaces and fills gaps, holes, or empty regions.

Select the surface to untrim, then select the untrim type. You can untrim all edges, internal edges, external edges, or manually select the edges you want to untrim.

name: Midsurface Shell
tooltip:
Creates a new midsurface shell from the selected body.

Select the face to midsurface.

name: Offset Shell
tooltip:
Creates a new offset shell at a given distance from the selected face.

Select the face to offset then specify the distance.

name: Shell from Surface
tooltip:
Creates a new surface shell from the surface.

Select the surface to surface shell.

name: Revolve
tooltip:
Revolves a sketch profile or planar face around a selected axis.

Select a profile or planar face and an axis to revolve around, then specify the extent type, direction, and operation.

name: Sweep
tooltip:
Sweeps a sketch profile or planar face along a selected path.

Select the profile then select the sweep path. The distance for the sweep is a decimal percentage of the selected path.

name: Validate
tooltip:
Checks the quality of selected surfaces and attempts to heal surfaces before stitching into quilts and solids.

Select the surfaces to check, specify a tolerance then select the type of validation to perform.

name: PCB Profile
tooltip:
Define the shape of the PCB via a sketched profile.

Select a profile and an origin point.

name: Copy EAGLE Profile
tooltip: Copies the profile supplied from EAGLE to an upstream Fusion sketch.

name: Finish PCB
tooltip: Return to the Model workspace.

name: Create Unlinked PCB
tooltip:
Creates a 3D PCB document from the selected sketch or face.

Select a sketch or face, then select origin and axes orientation. You can convert circles into non-plated through holes (NPTHs).

name: Derive PCB
tooltip:
Derives a new 3D PCB Document from a sketch profile. The derived profile replaces the board outline sketch. Updates to the derived features in the original design reflect in the destination design.

Select a sketch profile, then select the origin and axes orientation.

name: PCB Status
tooltip:
Check the status of the PCB shape and component positions.

Both the board shape and the component positions can be driven by either Fusion or EAGLE. Use this command to understand the state of the model.

name: Move PCB Components
tooltip:
Move PCB components to new locations on the board.

Select a component and move it by dragging or typing in values.

name: Replace Component Body
tooltip:
Replace PCB component with different one.

Select a PCB 3d model(step, stp file format) to replace existing PCB component.

name: Update PCB Component
tooltip:
Update PCB component from library.

Download PCB component from library to replace existing PCB component.

name: Move PCB Component body
tooltip:
Move PCB component body to align with the footprint on the board.

Select a body from PCB component and move it by dragging or typing in values.

name: Edit EAGLE Profile
tooltip: Edit the sketch generated from EAGLE board.

name: Flip Component
tooltip:
Unavailable when board is not defined.

To use 3D PCB tools, first edit the outline sketch to draw a closed profile, then Define Board to select a profile to create the PCB body.

name: Move Component
tooltip:
Unavailable when board is not defined.

To use 3D PCB tools, first edit the outline sketch to draw a closed profile, then Define Board to select a profile to create the PCB body.

name: Define Board
tooltip:
Defines the PCB board outline and 2D coordinate system.

Select one or more closed profiles from the Board Outline Sketch or mechanical assembly. Choose a point for the origin of the 2D coordinate system and an edge for the X axis. Flip the X and Z axes to set the desired Y axis.

name: Edit Board Outline Sketch
tooltip:
Edits the primary sketch that defines the board outline.

Create a closed profile to define the board. You can project geometry from the assembly context to ensure the PCB outline stays updated with the mechanical assembly.

name: PCBHole
tooltip:
Unavailable when board is not defined.

To use 3D PCB tools, first edit the outline sketch to draw a closed profile, then Define Board to select a profile to create the PCB body.

name: Create PCB Sketch
tooltip:
Unavailable when board is not defined.

To use 3D PCB tools, first edit the outline sketch to draw a closed profile, then Define Board to select a profile to create the PCB body.

name: Create Linked PCB
tooltip:
Creates a new 3D PCB document as an external component in the assembly. If the board outline sketch references assembly geometry, the board updates with design changes.

Select location, then open the 3D PCB to complete a closed profile in the board outline to finish defining the board.

name: Boss
tooltip:
Creates a boss feature to fasten two solid bodies together and reinforce thin areas of a design.

Select a sketch point between two solid bodies, then adjust the settings for each side of the boss feature and the fastener that will assemble them together.

name: Snap Fit
tooltip:
Creates a cantilever snap fit feature to fasten two solid bodies together in a design.

Select a snap fit type, select a sketch point between two solid bodies, then adjust the settings for the hook, groove, or loop on each side of the snap fit feature.

name: Rest
tooltip:
Creates a rest feature that intersects the overall shape and forms a flat area that can be used for other features or placement of other components.

Select a closed sketch profile and a solid body, then specify the thickness.

name: Lip
tooltip:
Creates a lip, groove, or combined feature on one or two solid bodies.

Select an edge on a solid body then choose between the Lip, Groove, or Lip And Groove types. Select a guide type, a pull direction or guide face to locate the feature, then adjust the dimension settings. Optionally, select one or two extents for the feature and choose a result option.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a boss feature to fasten two solid bodies together and reinforce thin areas of a design.

Select a sketch point between two solid bodies, then adjust the settings for each side of the boss feature and the fastener that will assemble them together.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a cantilever snap fit feature to fasten two solid bodies together in a design.

Select a snap fit type, select a sketch point between two solid bodies, then adjust the settings for the hook, groove, or loop on each side of the snap fit feature.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a rest feature that intersects the overall shape and forms a flat area that can be used for other features or placement of other components.

Select a closed sketch profile and a solid body, then specify the thickness.

name: Edit Feature
tooltip:
Creates a lip, groove, or combined feature on one or two solid bodies.

Select an edge on a solid body then choose between the Lip, Groove, or Lip And Groove types. Select a guide type, a pull direction or guide face to locate the feature, then adjust the dimension settings. Optionally, select one or two extents for the feature and choose a result option.

name: Manage Plastic Rules
tooltip:
Manages plastic rules in the active design to automatically control properties of plastic features, like physical material and thickness.

Create new rules, edit existing rules, or save rules to a library to use them in multiple designs.

name: Assign Plastic Rule
tooltip:
Assigns a plastic rule to a component to automatically control the properties of plastic features, like physical material and thickness.

Select a component, then select the plastic rule to assign to it.

name: Assign Plastic Rule
tooltip:
Assign Plastic Rule

Assign a different plastic rule to this component.

name: Design Advice
tooltip:
Identifies manufacturability concerns based on best practices for plastic injection molding, and provides recommendations to address them.

Select a solid body and the pull direction, then click Analyze. Once the analysis is complete, the rules, results, and recommendations display.

name: New Simulation Study
tooltip:
Creates a new simulation study.

Select a study type and define settings specific to this study type.

name: New Generative Study
tooltip:
Creates a generative study where you can define a design problem to generate outcomes for it.

You can create multiple studies in one design to define different design problems for a common set of geometry called a generative model.

name: New Generative Study
tooltip:
Creates a generative study where you can define a design problem to generate an outcome(s) for it.

You can create multiple studies in one project to define different design problems for a common set of geometry called a generative model.

name: New Simulation Study From Generative Design
tooltip:
Creates a new Static Stress simulation study from the setup of a generative study.

The new study has the same load case attributes as the generative study. The material from the selected outcome is applied. Select the same units as for the outcome in the Explore workspace.

name: Explore Generative Results
tooltip:
Explores design alternatives, called outcomes, using tools that help you identify the optimal outcome.

Use different views to visually explore outcomes and examine their properties. Apply filters and compare multiple outcomes. Explore an outcome in detail in the 3D view and select an outcome iteration.

name: Explore Generative Results
tooltip:
Explores design alternatives, called outcomes, using tools that help you identify the optimal outcome.

Use different views to visually explore outcomes and examine their properties. Apply filters and compare multiple outcomes. Explore an outcome in detail in the 3D view and select an outcome iteration.

name: Thumbnail View
tooltip:
Displays thumbnails of individual outcomes.

To identify outcomes that best meet your requirements, sort them by properties and apply view filters. To examine an outcome in 3D, click a thumbnail. View an outcome's previous iterations by moving the cursor over the blue bar.

name: Properties View
tooltip:
Displays properties of individual outcomes.

To identify outcomes that best meet your requirements, sort them by properties and apply view filters. To examine an outcome in 3D, click a thumbnail.

name: Scatter Plot View
tooltip:
Displays a scatter plot of outcomes.

Select properties to display on axes and see the outcomes' distribution on the scatter plot. Consider removing view filters to display all outcomes. Map a property to dots' colors. Click a dot to select an outcome and access outcome options.

name: Table View
tooltip:
Displays a table of outcomes' properties.

To identify outcomes that best meet your requirements, sort them by properties by clicking column headers and apply view filters. Click a row to select an outcome and access its options. To examine an outcome in 3D, click an outcome image.

name: Model View
tooltip:
Displays an outcome’s 3D view.

To examine details, orbit, pan, and zoom the outcome using tools on the 3D view toolbar.

name: Model View
tooltip:
Displays an outcome’s 3D view.

To examine details, orbit, pan, and zoom the outcome using tools on the 3D view toolbar.

name: Transparent View
tooltip:
Displays a transparent view of the outcome.

It enables you to see the internal empty spaces, called voids, that may occur during the outcome generation. To examine details, manipulate the outcome using tools on the 3D view toolbar.

name: Transparent View
tooltip:
Displays a transparent view of the outcome.

It enables you to see the internal empty spaces, called voids, that may occur during the outcome generation. To examine details, manipulate the outcome using tools on the 3D view toolbar.

name: Stress View
tooltip:
Displays the stress distribution map based on the factor of safety set in the Objectives and Limits dialog in the Generative Design workspace.

To view colors' explanations, mouse over the Stress reference legend. Red indicates the factor of safety lower than the target set in the dialog. To examine details, manipulate the outcome using tools on the 3D view toolbar.

name: Pressure View
tooltip:
Displays the pressure distribution map to help you evaluate the pressure drop across the fluid path.

To view the values that correspond to colors in the map, refer to the legend. To examine details, manipulate the outcome using tools on the Outcome View toolbar.

name: Flow Line View
tooltip:
Displays lines and arrows that help you understand the fluid motion through a device.

Flow lines represent the fluid velocity. Blue indicates a low velocity and red - high. Flow lines grow thicker as the velocity increases. Arrows represent the flow direction and grow with the flow velocity.

name: Design Preview
tooltip:
Displays a preview of a design to be created from the outcome.

It enables you to view the design with the appearance of the material selected in your study. Available for the final iteration of an outcome. To close the preview, click the color button in the top left corner of the view.

name: Design Preview
tooltip:
Displays a preview of a flow path design to be created from the outcome.

It enables you to view the design with the appearance of the fluid material defined in your study. Available for the final iteration of an outcome. To close, the preview, click the color button in the top left corner of the view.

name: Preserve Geometry View
tooltip:
Displays preserve geometries from your study setup in the Outcome View.

Preserve geometries display in green on the canvas. Manipulate the outcome to see how they influenced the final shape.

name: Preserve Geometry View
tooltip:
Displays preserve geometries from your study setup in the Outcome View.

Preserve geometries display in green on the canvas. Manipulate the outcome to see how they influenced the final shape.

name: Obstacle Geometry View
tooltip:
Displays obstacle geometries from your study setup in the Outcome View.

Obstacle geometries display in red on the canvas and they are semi-transparent. Manipulate the outcome to see how they influenced the final shape.

name: Obstacle Geometry View
tooltip:
Displays obstacle geometries from your study setup in the Outcome View.

Obstacle geometries display in red on the canvas and they are semi-transparent. Manipulate the outcome to see how they influenced the final shape.

name: Starting Shape View
tooltip:
Displays a starting shape from your study setup in the Outcome View.

The starting shape displays in yellow on the canvas and it’s semi-transparent. Manipulate the outcome to see how it influenced the final shape.

name: Starting Shape View
tooltip:
Displays a starting shape from your study setup in the Outcome View.

The starting shape displays in yellow on the canvas and it’s semi-transparent. Manipulate the outcome to see how it influenced the final shape.

name: Compare
tooltip:
Adds a new outcome to the comparison view.

You can compare up to four outcomes. Outcome views are synchronized. To remove an outcome from the view, click X.

name: Compare
tooltip:
Adds a new outcome to the comparison view.

You can compare up to four outcomes. Outcome views are synchronized. To remove an outcome from the view, click X.

name: Compare
tooltip:
Adds a new outcome to the comparison view.

You can compare up to four outcomes. Outcome views are synchronized. To remove an outcome from the view, click X.

name: Compare
tooltip:
You are comparing the maximum number of outcomes.

You can compare up to four outcomes. Outcome views are synchronized. To remove an outcome from the view, click X.

name: Design from Outcome
tooltip:
Creates an editable 3D design from the current outcome's iteration.

Track the processing status in the Job Status dialog. When the design is ready, open it on another tab and edit using T-Spline tools.

name: Design from Outcome
tooltip:
Creates a 3D flow path design which you can edit, from the current outcome's iteration.

Track the processing status in the Job Status dialog. When the design is ready, open it on another tab and edit using T-Spline tools.

name: Mesh Design from Outcome
tooltip:
Creates a 3D design where a mesh represents model's surfaces, from the current outcome's iteration.

Track the processing status in the Job Status dialog. When the mesh design is ready, open it on another tab.

name: Mesh Design from Outcome
tooltip:
Creates a 3D flow path design where a mesh represents model's surfaces, from the current outcome's iteration.

Track the processing status in the Job Status dialog. When the mesh design is ready, open it on another tab.

name: Add to Favorites
tooltip:
Adds an outcome iteration to favorites.

Once in favorites, you can easily view and compare it with other outcomes in the Explore views. To select the iteration, click and drag along the Iterations bar at the bottom of the Outcome View.

name: Add Label
tooltip:
Adds a label to an outcome iteration.

Add labels to organize and group outcomes. To display the outcomes, use the Labels filters. To rename and delete labels, go to the Outcome filters pane.

name: Export CSV
tooltip:
Exports a table of outcomes' data to a CSV file.

Create a CSV file for the current filters and settings that you can import to spreadsheet programs or text editors. For example, you can create the file for selected manufacturing methods or materials. The file contains only numbers and text.

name: Finish Explore
tooltip: Exits the Explore workspace and returns to the Generative Design workspace.

name: Finish Outcome View
tooltip: Return to Explore

name: Finish Results
tooltip: Exits the Results environment and returns you to the Setup environment.

name: Finish Results
tooltip: Exits the Results environment and returns you to the Setup environment.

name: Clone Study
tooltip:
Clones the selected study, which you can then quickly modify to generate new results.

Select either the active or an inactive study to clone. Make incremental changes to the setup parameters to test how the model performs.

name: Clone Study
tooltip:
Clones the selected study, which you can then quickly modify to generate new outcomes.

Select either the active or an inactive study to clone. Make changes to the study setup to see how they affect the generation of outcomes.

name: Settings
tooltip: Enables you to view and modify all settings for the current simulation study.

name: Study Settings
tooltip:
Enables you to define the settings for the current generative study.

Use the Study Settings dialog to control the resolution and accuracy of outcomes. Additionally, for an unconstrained model, you can select the Remove rigid body modes option to stabilize your model.

name: Mesh Settings
tooltip:
View and modify mesh definition for whole model.

Customize the mesh distribution for your simulation study. It is a good idea to check the mesh using the Generate Mesh command prior to running the simulation.

name: Adaptive Mesh Refinement
tooltip:
Enable and modify Adaptive Mesh Refinement.

Adaptive Mesh Refinement iteratively improves the mesh based on computed results. The goal is to reach a solution that does not change with further mesh refinement.

name: Study Materials
tooltip:
Compares the materials chosen for the Simulation model against those in the Design model, and enables you to change the Simulation model materials.

For accurate results, make sure you assign materials to your Simulation model that best represent the actual material that will be used for production.

name: Material Properties
tooltip: Displays material properties.

name: Manage Physical Materials
tooltip:
Lists properties for each material in the Fusion libraries, that control the material's thermal, mechanical, and elastic behavior, as well as its appearance.

Use the Material Browser to identify favorites, modify properties, create new materials, and manage personal libraries.

name: Manage Physical Materials
tooltip:
Lists properties for each material in the Fusion libraries, that control the material's thermal, mechanical, and elastic behavior, as well as its appearance.

Use the Material Browser to identify favorites, modify properties, create new materials, and manage personal libraries.

name: Update Simulation Study
tooltip: Update Active Simulation Study

name: Update simulation study results from cloud storage.
DOF View
tooltip:
Shows the degrees of freedom status for each body.

Use DOF View to identify where contacts or constraints are needed. Change the Fully Fixed color to invisible to reveal free bodies that are hard to find.

name: Groups View
tooltip:
Uses colors to show groups of connected bodies with bonded contacts.

Each group has a different color. Bodies with missing contacts, or with other types of contact, are colored gray.

name: Model View
tooltip:
Displays the model components with the original design appearances.

Select Display Study Material Colors from the Materials panel to see the material colors.

name: Isolate
tooltip:
Hides all unselected or unrelated Bodies and Components.

It can be used for components, bodies, and study attributes such as loads. The Unisolate will show all of the components and bodies that were hidden.

name: Unisolate
tooltip: Reverts all isolations.

name: Switch to Fusion Model
tooltip: Go to the Model workspace where you can view and edit the model.

name: View Results
tooltip: Display model using calculated results.

name: Mesh View
tooltip: Display model using computed mesh.

name: Job Status
tooltip:
Displays a list of all the studies that have solved, or are in progress, in all your open documents.

Track the progress of running jobs, cancel them, or access the results of completed studies.

name: Job Status
tooltip:
Displays a list of all the generative jobs that have completed, or are in progress, in all your open documents.

Track the processing status of each generative job, view outcomes, and open designs for the successfully completed jobs.

You can cancel a generative job before one iteration of any outcome is generated.

name: Convergence Plot
tooltip: Monitor the progress of the simulation. Values of the active result type are displayed for each iteration as well as the convergence rate.

name: History
tooltip:
Displays the version history of the selected component.

Select a component to view its version history and optionally choose a different version.

name: Measure
tooltip:
Reports distance, angle, area, or position data of the selected object.

Select a vertex, edge, face, body, or component.

name: Compare
tooltip:
Enters Compare mode. Setup comparisons and access results of multiple simulations simultaneously. View results from different studies side by side.

Select Finish Compare to exit out of the mode.

name: Select By Size
tooltip:
Selects objects based on size.

Use the slider bars or directly input minimum and maximum size values to select objects.

name: Invert Selection
tooltip: Inverts the active selection by obeying the options of Selection Tools and Selection Filters.

name: Select By Boundary
tooltip:
Selects objects defined by boundaries.

Set the centroid, shape, and shape direction of the boundary. Specify if objects are selected within the boundary and if they can intersect the boundary.

name: Select All Occurrences
tooltip: Selects other instances of the same body and component automatically.

name: Select Similar Occurrences
tooltip: Selects other bodies in the model that resemble the same dimensions.

name: Select By Name
tooltip:
Selects objects by name.

Enter the object name and set the type. Find the object and select if appropriate.

name: Send Study to Ansys® Mechanical™
tooltip:
Send geometry, loads, constraints, and materials of the active study to Ansys Mechanical.

The same study that was set up in Fusion is created automatically, although some loads and constraints may need to be recreated in Ansys Mechanical.

name: Send Study to Ansys® Discovery™
tooltip:
Send geometry, loads, constraints, and materials of the active study to Ansys Discovery.

The same study that was set up in Fusion is created automatically, although some loads and constraints may need to be recreated in Ansys Discovery.

name: Export Study to Ansys® Setup
tooltip:
Export geometry, loads, constraints, and materials of the active study to Ansys Setup.

When you import the .sdz file into an Ansys product, the same study that was set up in Fusion is created automatically, although some loads and constraints may need to be recreated.

name: Solve Details
tooltip:
Displays information about jobs in the active document, including whether or not they ran successfully.

Errors and warnings are also listed, with suggestions on how to resolve them. You can save this information to a log file, or share it in an e-mail.

name: Generate Details
tooltip:
Displays information about the generation of outcomes for one or more studies.

Available information includes the outcome generation status. You can save this information to a log file.

name: Display Study Material Colors
tooltip:
Colors the model according to the materials selected for the Simulation study.

When this option is not selected, the study material colors are hidden and the Design workspace material colors are shown instead.

name: Two Horizontal Views
tooltip:
Opens two windows so you can compare the data from two different results, one above the other.

Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: Two Vertical Views
tooltip:
Opens two windows so you can compare the data from two different results, side-by-side.

Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: One Vertical and Two Horizontal Views
tooltip:
Opens three windows so you can examine the data from three results, one to the left of the other two.
Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: One Horizontal and Two Vertical Views
tooltip:
Opens three windows so you can examine the data from three results, one above the other two.
Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: Four Views
tooltip:
Opens four windows so you can examine the data from four different results.

Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: One Horizontal and Three Vertical Views
tooltip:
Opens four windows so you can examine the data from four results, one above the other three.
Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: One Vertical and Three Horizontal Views
tooltip:
Opens four windows so you can examine the data from four results, one to the left of the other three.
Click on a window to activate it to select a different result. Compare results from the same study or from different studies.

name: Synchronize Cameras
tooltip:
Synchronizes the movement and orientation of the models in all windows, based on the active window, so you can move, rotate, zoom in or out, and pan all models in the same way and at the same time.

Click Synchronize Cameras to deactivate it, when you want to manipulate the models independently.

name: Synchronize Result Types
tooltip:
Synchronizes the result selection so that all windows show the same result type as the active window.

On by default, this command only synchronizes results from the same study type. Deactivate to view different results from the same study, or across different study types.

name: Synchronize Legends
tooltip:
Synchronizes the legend range for all results of the same type, so you can compare the results more effectively.

On by default, this command also changes the result settings and legend behavior in all non-active windows to match the behavior in the active window. Deactivate to manipulate the legends independently.

name: Synchronize Animations
tooltip:
Synchronizes the animation controls so that all animated results move to the next frame, stop, pause, and loop at the same time.

This command activates automatically if the active result is an animated result when you enter Compare. Deactivate the command to control animations independently.

name: Show All Probes
tooltip: Makes visible all probes that you have previously hidden, so you can see the data in their labels again.

name: Hide All Probes
tooltip:
Hides all probes and the information labels associated with them.
If you no longer need the probe information, an alternative is to delete the probes, using Delete All Probes from the toolbar Inspect panel.

name: Delete All Probes
tooltip:
Removes all probes and the information associated with them.
To hide the probe information, without deleting the probes, select Hide All Probes from the toolbar Inspect panel.

name: Convergence Plot
tooltip:
Shows how the data changes at each iterative step as the mesh element size is decreased.

This plot is generated when you enable adaptive mesh refinement before you solve.

name: Mass Participation Factors
tooltip:
Use the Mass Participation Factor to assess the percentage of the system mass that participates per direction for each mode.
Note that modes with a large effective mass participation typically have a stronger influence on the system response.

name: Simulation Results
tooltip: Shows how your model performs under the study setup conditions.

name: View Results
tooltip: Shows how your model performs under the study setup conditions.

name: Mesh View
tooltip:
Displays the mesh as a reference over the result plot.

Check the mesh quality if you see unusual result values, such as stress. An overly coarse mesh, or unusual mesh element shapes, can lead to inaccurate results, so refine as necessary.

name: Wireframe View
tooltip: Displays the undeformed wireframe as a reference, to show how much the model deflects in response to the applied loads and constraints.

name: Undeformed
tooltip: Displays the results on the undeformed model.

name: Actual
tooltip:
Displays the calculated deformation.

The actual deformation is often too small to see. Actual is the default for Nonlinear Static Stress and Event Simulation studies where large displacements are expected.

name: Adjusted 0.5x
tooltip:
Displays half the deformation compared to Adjusted.

Use Adjusted 0.5x when the deformation appears too large using Adjusted.

name: Adjusted
tooltip:
Displays the deformation on an adjusted scale.

This is the default for all studies except Nonlinear Static Stress and Event Simulation.

name: Adjusted 2x
tooltip:
Displays twice the deformation compared to Adjusted.

Use Adjusted 2x when the model shape does not change enough to see where the deformation occurs.

name: Adjusted 5x
tooltip:
Displays five times the deformation compared to Adjusted.

Use Adjusted 5x when the model shape does not change enough to see the deformation clearly.

name: Reactions
tooltip:
Lists the forces and moments a constrained model generates in response to applied loads.

Use reactions to check your study setup. The sum of the reactions should be equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the total applied loads.

name: Center of Mass
tooltip:
Lists the location of the original and displaced center of mass, and the displacement vector.

The displaced center of mass is shown on the model by a glyph.

name: Load Case Attributes
tooltip:
Shows the location, magnitude, and direction of all Items in the study load case, in one place, for easy access.

Where applicable, the load case includes the loads, constraints, and gravity settings that you define.

name: Solver Data
tooltip:
Displays a summary of the mesh details and solver status to help you troubleshoot your study results.

Switch to Solver Output to see the solver log, which includes solver details, time statistics, warnings, and errors.

name: Solver Data
tooltip: View solver information and statistics about the current study.

name: Legend Min/Max
tooltip:
Reduces the range of result values shown on the legend, while maintaining the entire spectrum of colors, to give you a more granular view of particular areas of interest on the model.

Use the legend sliders to make transparent values that are of no interest to you.

name: Legend Options
tooltip:
Customize the legend appearance.
Specify the size, color transition, and plot shading. The Legend appearance can be unique in every displayed view.

name: Reset
tooltip: Resets minimum referential value.

name: Reset
tooltip: Resets maximum referential value.

name: Results Details
tooltip: Shows result recommendations.

name: Legend Size/Shape
tooltip: Specify the shape and size of the Results Legend. The appearance of the legend can be unique in every view displayed.

name: Active Study View
tooltip: Select simulation study for comparison from list of studies in your document.
